**Required benchmark is missing** This changes `message_start` serialization, but adds no benchmark for that branch. `AGENTS.md` requires request-path changes to include a `Benchmark*` in the existing test file and before/after `ns/op` and `allocs/op` results from `-benchmem`. The PR description provides neither results nor an exemption. Add a focused benchmark in `invoke_test.go` and record the results before merging. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/b0d094c7f898d6acff6930175d8752eb44f41f13/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

** Minor** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Add the required request-path benchmark evidence for this stream change.** The Created stream branch now adds two fields to every `message_start` event (`core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go:2248-2249`). AGENTS.md requires request-path streaming changes to ship a `Benchmark*` in the existing `_test.go` file, run with `-benchmem`. The PR body must then record allocs/op and ns/op before and after. Neither the diff nor the PR body does this, and the body does not explain why the change cannot be benchmarked. Add a benchmark for the stream conversion path in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`. Record the before and after `-benchmem` results in the PR body. Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the Bedrock fix and the specific change: null stop_reason and stop_sequence on the InvokeModel stream message_start event. This matches the changeset, which adds those fields to the message_start map in invoke.go, adds a regression test, and updates the changelog.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template. It has Summary, Changes, Type of change (Bug fix checked), Affected areas (Core and Providers checked), How to test with commands and expected outcome, Breaking changes (No), and Related issues (Fixes `#9538`). It omits the Screenshots section, which is optional for non-UI changes. The checklist and Security considerations sections are absent. Those gaps are non-critical, so the check passes.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to include `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR diff (merge base 8907f9b to head 2f759d9) adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `msgStart` literal map in `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes` in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go`. Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys are present and null. The `message_delta` branch is not changed. The test `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields` in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` now was read. It asserts that both keys are present and nil in the decoded `message_start.message` object. This covers the coding requirement. The issue scope about `message_start.usage` ([`#5885`]) is not required here.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR changes are: `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` (two nil-valued keys, confirmed by diff), `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` (one regression test for the same keys, confirmed by diff), `core/changelog.md` (one Bedrock fix entry, per change summary), and `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` (+65/-0, one Bedrock streaming regression case checking the same `message_start.message` fields, per change summary). All of these support [`#9538`]. No change to `message_start.usage` ([`#5885`]) or to the `message_delta` branch is present. The e2e JSON and changelog diffs were not read directly in this pass. Their conclusion rests on the change summary, which reports additions only. No unrelated change is identified.
Full details: Audit Commit Point

**Explanation** The check applies only to changed handlers under transports/bifrost-http/handlers/. The reviewed range changes four files: core/changelog.md, core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go, core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go, and tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json. A diff restricted to transports/bifrost-http/handlers/ returned no files, so no changed handler exists to audit. The PR adds "stop_reason": nil and "stop_sequence": nil to the message_start map in toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes. That is a stream payload change in the Bedrock provider and does not add a write-then-error path or an audit step. The check is inapplicable, so it passes.
